name: claude-godmode
description: Senior engineering team in a plugin: one clear workflow (mission → brief → plan → build → verify → ship), 18 specialized agents, quality-gate enforcement, and CI. Language-agnostic.

model_profile.title: Model profile
model_profile.description: Model/effort preset for all agents. One of: quality, balanced, budget. 'quality' = opus + xhigh (code-writing agents stay capped at effort:high); 'balanced' = each agent's own frontmatter values; 'budget' = haiku + default effort. See README FAQ for the full preset table and feasibility caveat.
